title: Design a Real-Time Chat System (like WhatsApp/Slack)
description: Design a real-time messaging system supporting 1:1 and group chats.
hints: WebSocket vs long polling vs SSE — when would you use each?
How do you maintain millions of concurrent WebSocket connections?
Message ordering: why can't you just use timestamps?
How does the presence system work without overwhelming the network?
Think about message storage — read-heavy or write-heavy?
